material: Faraday Factory Japan YBCO 2G HTS; manufacturer designation #1043-N1
coordinate_policy: Measured temperature, source Field, and Hall angle; commanded coordinates define connectivity only. Hall angle unwrapped by full turns toward commanded angle.
normalization: Published Ic/w (A/cm) multiplied by 100 to A/m; no scaling to a commercial full-width tape capacity.
limitations: One patterned 0.5 mm bridge from a 4 mm tape, not a manufacturer lot guarantee or measured full-width tape capacity.
Applied-field transport data includes sample self-field effects; not an intrinsic local Jc(B) law.
Maximum Lorentz-force geometry only; no arbitrary field azimuth, strain model or quantified measurement uncertainty.
No angle reflection/folding or out-of-domain extrapolation is assumed.
Selection is a declared characterization region, not coverage of all fusion magnet operating conditions.
Measured on a 4 mm tape; per-width capacity does not account for width-dependent slitting or substrate differences in other widths.
Fields span 0.01-8 T including a dense 0.01-0.7 T decade the peer datasets do not cover; the 0 T self-field rows are excluded (no positive applied field to interpolate against).
Angle mesh is denser near the ab-plane peak (1-2 deg source setpoints at 75-105 deg) than elsewhere (5 deg); the declared 0-180 deg window matches the other Robinson datasets.
